relations.subject: Alfred John Hiltebeitel
relations.role: Columbian Professor of Religion, History, and Human Sciences
relations.evidence: Alfred John Hiltebeitel (April 10, 1942 - March 12, 2023) was Columbian Professor of Religion, History, and Human Sciences at George Washington University in Washington, D.C., US.

relations.subject: Alfred John Hiltebeitel
relations.evidence: Hiltebeitel was awarded a B.A. degree from Haverford College, where he majored in religion and minored in English (1959-1963).

relations.subject: Alfred John Hiltebeitel
relations.evidence: He attended the University of Chicago Divinity School, where he obtained an M.A. (1966) and a Ph.D. (1973) in the history of religions.

relations.subject: Alfred John Hiltebeitel
relations.evidence: He was appointed an assistant professor in religion at George Washington University (GWU) in 1968, and was promoted to associate professor there in 1974.
